title: “HOT” ChatGPT: The promise of ChatGPT in detecting and discriminating hateful, offensive, and toxic comments on social media
reasoning: The study focuses on the technical performance, reliability, and prompt engineering of ChatGPT for the task of toxicity detection. While the subject matter (hate speech and harmful content) has moral and ethical implications, and specific examples in the appendix involve religious contexts (e.g., pastors and faith), the paper does not systematically evaluate or benchmark religious frameworks, theological concepts, or moral/ethical philosophies.
